title: Man in a black duster carrying The Mothman Prophecies in a movie-theater parking lot
place_text: movie theater parking lot, Los Angeles

tellings.quote: he's holding a book. And it's the Moth Man prophecies.

plain: In a Los Angeles movie theater parking lot, the Hollywood writer and producer Bryce Zabel says, he and a fellow writer named Brent Friedman met a man in a long black duster coat who was holding a copy of The Mothman Prophecies, a book about sightings of a winged figure called the Mothman and the strange events around them. Zabel tells Michels he saw it himself. He tells it as one of those odd encounters that seem to come with digging into this subject.
